# Twin Lakes Epoxy

> Twin Lakes Epoxy is a locally owned, owner-operated epoxy and concrete coating contractor based in Mountain Home, Arkansas, serving a 75-mile radius across the Twin Lakes Area (Baxter, Marion, Boone, Fulton, Izard, and Sharp counties in Arkansas, plus Howell, Oregon, and Ozark counties in Missouri).

Twin Lakes Epoxy installs professional-grade polyaspartic/polyurea hybrid coating systems — durable and easy to clean — for garage floors, epoxy countertops, enclosed trailer floors, basements, patios, man caves/shops, churches/schools, and commercial spaces. Every install starts with full diamond-grinding surface prep. Free on-site estimates. Phone: 870-277-6195.

## Core Services

- [Residential Services](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/residential.html): Overview of all residential epoxy coating services.
- [Commercial Services](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/commercial.html): Industrial-grade coatings for warehouses, retail, auto shops, and restaurants.
- [Epoxy Garage Floors](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/garage-floors.html): The most popular service — full-broadcast flake and metallic garage floor systems.
- [Epoxy Counter Tops](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/counter-tops.html): Seamless, heat- and stain-resistant epoxy countertops for kitchens, bars, and bathrooms.
- [Enclosed Trailer Floor Coatings](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/enclosed-trailers.html): Coatings for cargo, car hauler, and concession trailer floors.
- [Basement Floor Coatings](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/basement-floors.html): Moisture-resistant coatings for basements, home gyms, and entertainment rooms.
- [Metallic Epoxy Floors](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/metallic-epoxy.html): Liquid-metal artistry pours for showcase garages and basements.
- [Patio & Outdoor Coatings](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/patio-coatings.html): UV- and slip-resistant coatings for patios, pool decks, and driveways.
- [ManCave & Shop Floors](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/mancave-shop.html): Custom colors and commercial-grade durability for shops and man caves.
- [Church & School Floor Coatings](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/churches-schools.html): Durable, slip-resistant coatings for institutional environments.
- [Concrete Repair & Sealing](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/concrete-repair.html): Standalone crack repair, joint filling, and sealing, with or without a coating system.
- [Floor Maintenance Plans](https://twinlakesepoxy.com/floor-maintenance.html): One-time deep cleans or recurring seasonal care plans to keep coated floors looking new.
